data.gender_notes: Hermie is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Hermes is the god of trade, commerce, thieves, travelers, sports, athletes, and guides. He is also the messenger of the gods, the conductor of souls to the underworld, and the god of boundaries, roads, and crossroads. He is the son of Zeus and Maia and is one of the twelve Olympians. The name Hermie carries the meaning “Hermes, messenger of the gods” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Hermie usually hope their child will grow to embody hermes, messenger of the gods and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hermie total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_greek.long_meaning: The name Hermie is derived from the Greek word Ἕρμιος (hermios), which means ‘soldier.’ This name reflects a sense of bravery and dedication, reminding us of the courage and strength that comes from God.

in_latin.name: Hermes
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Hermie has no direct equivalent in Latin, but it is related to the Latin god Hermes, the messenger of the gods. This name carries a sense of communication, travel, and divine protection.

in_english.name: Hermie
in_english.long_meaning: The name Hermie is a variant of Herman, which is derived from the Germanic word herm, meaning ‘army’ or ‘soldier.’ This name reflects a sense of power, strength, and bravery, reminding us of the strength and power of God.
